sections.title: AI Services for Los Angeles Insurance Organizations
sections.description: Custom AI solutions built for LA's property, auto, health, and InsurTech insurance sectors.

blocks.heading: Property Insurance Underwriting AI
paragraphs: California's property insurance crisis — major carriers including State Farm and Allstate withdrawing from the California homeowner market — has created both urgency and opportunity for AI-powered underwriting that can accurately model LA's complex property risk:

Wildfire risk scoring: ML modeling wildfire risk at the parcel level, incorporating topography, vegetation type and fuel load from satellite imagery, historical fire spread patterns, and proximity to ignition sources — producing defensible risk scores that can support CDI rate filing requirements.

Earthquake risk modeling: ML for seismic vulnerability assessment incorporating soil type, liquefaction risk, proximity to fault lines, and building construction type — applicable to LA's enormous stock of pre-1980 construction with limited seismic retrofitting.

Computer vision property inspection: Aerial and street-level imagery analysis for roof condition, vegetation proximity, and property maintenance scoring — enabling more accurate property risk assessment without the cost of physical inspections at scale.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | CDI rate filing context

blocks.heading: Auto Insurance ML
paragraphs: California's personal auto market — one of the US's largest — operates under unique California regulations (Proposition 103 rate approval requirements, CDI oversight):
Loss frequency and severity prediction: Geospatial ML incorporating California-specific risk factors — traffic density on LA freeways, uninsured motorist rates by zip code, local repair cost indices.

Claims triage and fraud detection: ML distinguishing legitimate from fraudulent auto claims in California's known high-fraud markets (specific LA corridors have significantly elevated staged accident rates).
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | CA Prop 103 / CDI context

blocks.heading: Health Insurance and Managed Care AI
paragraphs: LA's health insurance market — Covered California exchange, Medi-Cal managed care, commercial group insurance:
Member risk stratification: ML predicting member health cost and care needs for LA's health plans and managed care organizations — enabling proactive care management.
Prior authorization intelligence: AI streamlining PA processes for California's complex multi-payer authorization requirements.
Claims and fraud analytics: ML detecting unusual billing patterns, duplicate claims, and potential fraud in LA's large and complex health insurance market.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA + California DOI

sections.title: California Insurance Regulatory Context
sections.description: Compliance frameworks embedded in every LA insurance AI project.

blocks.heading: California Department of Insurance (CDI)
paragraphs: One of the US's most active state insurance regulators. Proposition 103 requires CDI rate approval for personal lines — any ML-based rate algorithm must be defensible to CDI examination. ClickMasters designs LA insurance AI with CDI rate filing and examination requirements in mind.

blocks.heading: CDI AI Bulletin (2022)
paragraphs: CDI has issued guidance specifically addressing AI and machine learning in insurance underwriting and claims — requiring fairness testing, documentation of AI decision factors, and prohibition of protected class proxies. ClickMasters designs all LA insurance AI with CDI AI Bulletin requirements.

blocks.heading: Proposition 103
paragraphs: California's voter-approved insurance regulation requires CDI approval for personal lines rates and prohibits certain pricing factors — ClickMasters designs auto and homeowner insurance AI with Prop 103 limitations explicitly incorporated.
